about_the_game:
Harvest souls. Expand your dominion. Unlock the secrets of the afterlife.

Soul Harvester is a dark Idle Clicker where you step into the role of an all-powerful soul harvester, collecting lost souls and expanding your influence across multiple dimensions. Progress through increasingly powerful upgrades, unlock new supernatural abilities, and dominate the Multiverse of the Beyond.

🕹️ Features:

✅ Idle Clicker Gameplay – Generate souls by clicking, then automate your production to expand your power.
✅ Prestige System ("The Harvester's Rebirth") – Sacrifice progress to gain permanent upgrades and push further.
✅ The Multiverse of the Beyond – Explore parallel dimensions, each with unique mechanics and challenges.
✅ Spiritual Hierarchy – Ascend from a mere Soul Collector to the ultimate Void Overlord.
✅ Dynamic Events – Face supernatural storms, divine judgments, and unpredictable blessings.
✅ 100+ Achievements – Unlock rewards as you progress, with secret challenges for the most dedicated players.
✅ Endless Progression – Keep growing, evolving, and dominating.

💀 Your destiny awaits. Will you become the Supreme Soul Reaper or vanish into oblivion?
detailed_description:
Roadmap

🚀 Future Updates & Expansions:

🔹 New Dimensions & Multiverse Expansions – Unique realms with distinct rules.

🔹 Competitive Mode – Weekly tournaments and leaderboards.

🔹 Story Mode – Uncover the origin of the Soul Harvester and their connection to the afterlife.

🔹 AI Assistant "Underworld Guardian" – A sentient AI guide that learns and offers strategic advice.

🔹 More Supernatural Events – Rare occurrences that shift the balance of power.
